$comment: What a device's unlock key signs to open a profile, with SHA-256 as the digest. Every implementation replays these: punktfunk-core msg.rs, pf-client-core unlock.rs, Swift, Kotlin. `seat` form: a profile on a person's own Linux account, `"punktfunk-seat-unlock-v1" ‖ challenge ‖ seat id (32 lowercase hex characters) ‖ device ‖ box`, 152 bytes. `challenge` is the 32 bytes `unlock-challenge` answered, `device` the SHA-256 of this device's certificate, `box` the SHA-256 of the host certificate this device pinned. `refused` lists ids no message is built for.

messages.name: seat form: the own-account contract vector
